title: MNBL generated-campaign id map
description: id-map.json written by worldbridge --compile-campaign (MMR-27), canonical JSON. One entry per generated object: its deterministic Bannerlord id, its object kind and the stable source UID it comes from. Ids never depend on display names. Synthesized objects use a UID derived from their source (clan:<realm uid>, regent:<realm uid>). Entries are sorted by id; ids are unique; (kind, uid) pairs are unique. An object excluded later (campaign.json exclusions) keeps its entry: its id stays reserved.

sourceIdentity.description: The source identity document (worldgen/contracts/source-identity.schema.json) exactly as worldbridge writes it: schema, stage, generator version, grid side and seeds

prefix.description: 'mnbl_' + hex(sha256('mnbl.world-prefix/2\n' + sourceIdentity + '\n' + worldSha256))[0:8]: different worlds get different prefixes even when they share a seed

id.description: prefix + '_' + kind code + '_' + hash prefix (10 hex digits by default, 26 characters in all)
